# Neural_Avalanche_Dynamics

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
The propagation of cascading neuronal activity bursts in EEG, characterized by size and duration distributions following power laws, reflecting self-organized criticality. Directly informs the design of spiking neural network architectures and reservoir computing topologies that emulate critical-state dynamics for efficient computation.
